fields.summary_ko.0: AVGO stock rose 4.3% in early trading on November 19 and fell 1.5% as of 2:25 PM, with fluctuation in valuation of $1 billion investment position linked to Anthropic IPO
fields.summary_ko.1: As Anthropic's IPO opened at $111.50 from an offering price of $83 and adjusted to $97, AVGO's investment position also reflected a loss of $385 million
